Ready to build valuable logistics experience and grow your skills? As an warehouse worker at Mainfreight in 's-Heerenberg, you will take ownership of your daily targets! You earn a good salary up to € 20,68 per hour, paid out weekly. Add your travel allowance and clear opportunities to learn new skills, and you have the perfect kickstart for your career. Apply directly and showcase your talent!

What we offer
- A gross hourly wage from € 15,32!
- Weekly payout directly to your bank!
- Day shifts or 2 shifts!
- Travel compensation up to € 16,96 per day!
- An international work environment!
- Room for autonomy and skill growth!

Who you are
To keep the logistics operations running sharp as an orderpicker, you meet the following requirements:

- You speak and understand English.
- You are available full-time or part-time for 32 to 40 hours per week.
- You can work at the location in 's-Heerenberg.
- You are available to work between 7:00 and 00:00.
- You have your own transportation to reach the location in 's-Heerenberg.

What will you do
As an warehouse worker in the Rituals department, you run an efficient workflow using modern logistics tools. Equipped with a headset and voicepicking system, you collect orders accurately and independently. You get the space to master the system quickly and drive an EPT truck safely through the aisles.

You work from Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 17:00 or in shifts (7:00-15:00 and 15:15-00:00) , giving you complete freedom over your evenings and weekends! Everything is possible as an warehouse worker!

Where will you work
Mainfreight is a powerful global player in supply chain solutions with over 330 branches worldwide. At the 's-Heerenberg location, you get the autonomy to perform at your best. You are encouraged to show initiative, learn every aspect of the warehouse, and discuss your performance regularly with your supervisor. Ambition is valued here!

Job application
Ready to take responsibility and prove yourself as an order

Do you speak fluent English AND added as second language fluently German or French? 

Finished your Bachelor Degree and looking for a job in the business sector? Send me a message to discuss your possibilities.

Conventional Lathe Operator

Conventional turning outdated? Not in our work!
Alongside CNC machining, conventional techniques continue to offer plenty of challenges.

You will perform turning operations on components up to Ø1,500 x 8,000 mm, weights up to 8,000 kg. Most parts are one-offs, requiring precise work, patience, and perseverance. 
First time right is more important than speed.
In addition to conventional turning, knowledge of 3-axis CNC milling is preferred. 
If you don’t have this yet, no problem! You are eager to learn and willing to develop these skills.

We understand that it can take 1 to 2 years for a new colleague to reach the desired level in our field. 

We start with a one-year contract, but aim to convert it to a permanent position as soon as possible.
We work daytime shifts, and a 4-day workweek is available if you prefer.

Requirements 
•    At least a level 3 vocational education (MBO 3) or equivalent; a completed qualification is a plus but not required.
•    Hands-on experience in machining.
•    Practical, solution-oriented, and eager to learn.

Personal qualities
•    Patient and persistent, with a strong work ethic
•    Thinks before starting a task
•    Works in a structured and precise manner, with a clear understanding of the job at hand
•    Able to work independently, but also thrives in a team environment
•    Speaks English 

Examples of jobs
- Compressor rotor
- Double-acting hydraulic cylinder
- Screw compressor housing
- Turbine shaft
- Drive roller
- Propeller shaft

Please send your resume/cv and  motivation to annelies.jansen-01@uwv.nl
